g.data-name: Artwork / fitted bitmap, source preserved separately
UNCOMMON / antique bronze, paired rules, leaf corners
Rarity / antique bronze, paired rules, leaf corners
Portrait inlay / rank and figure emblems

text.tspan: A copyist preserves arguments with a steady hand,
protecting distinctions that careless writing could erase.
The work carries a lesson beyond the speaker's voice,
giving the Lyceum's inquiry a lasting memory.
